scripts.build:envs: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir dist/staging && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist/production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node ../../scripts/check-deploy-config.mjs staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: node ../../scripts/check-deploy-config.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.deploy:staging: node ../../scripts/check-deploy-config.mjs staging && pnpm --filter @hackathon/web run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: node ../../scripts/check-deploy-config.mjs production && pnpm --filter @hackathon/web run build && wrangler deploy --env production
